data.title: 冬马和纱 · 抽出的唱片
data.description: 唱片架前，她抽出一张唱片，侧过头仔细辨认封面上的名字。
data.action: holding a record sleeve and reading its cover
data.lighting: 私人音乐室复古留声机旁暖黄壁灯与落地窗外落雪
data.promptProse: In the narrow aisle of an underground secondhand vinyl shop, Kazusa holds an imported classical piano record sleeve under a low-hanging Edison bulb, closely reading the German liner notes. Towering cardboard bins of vintage jazz and classical records surround her, steeped in the comforting scent of aged cardboard and vinyl dust.
data.animaCaption: Warm amber lamplight softly touches Kazusa's slender fingers pulling a vinyl record from the shelf as snow falls outside.
